name: Candlelight: Disney Journeys
description: A string quartet plays Disney songs from films set around the world, by candlelight at Hilton Porto Gaia. Saturday 5 December at 21:30, tickets from €21.50.
longDescription:
This Candlelight concert takes Disney songs from films set in very different places and plays them live with a string quartet, in a room lit only by candles. The trip goes from the African savanna of The Lion King to the New Orleans of The Princess and the Frog. It's a licensed Disney Concerts presentation.

The programme includes Be Our Guest, Do You Want to Build a Snowman?, Prince Ali, I Wan'na Be Like You, We Don't Talk About Bruno, Un Poco Loco, You've Got a Friend in Me, He Mele No Lilo, You're Welcome, Strangers Like Me and Circle of Life, among others. The concert runs for 60 minutes and is open to ages 5 and up. Under-16s need to come with an adult.

It's on Saturday 5 December at 21:30 at Hilton Porto Gaia, and tickets start at €21.50. Doors open 30 minutes before and close 5 minutes before the start, and nobody gets in once the music begins. Seats go by order of arrival within your ticket type, so arriving early gets you a better spot. The venue is accessible for people with reduced mobility.
